mechanism: Berberine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase darunavir plasma concentrations, while darunavir (a CYP3A4 substrate and moderate inhibitor) may increase berberine levels, creating bidirectional metabolic interaction.
action: Monitor for darunavir toxicity and therapeutic efficacy; consider berberine dose reduction or discontinuation; counsel patient to avoid concurrent use if possible and maintain consistent dosing intervals.
